content: We optimize RAMEN$_{\textsc {base}}$ using Lookahead optimizer BIBREF25 wrapped around Adam with the learning rate of $10^{-4}$, the number of fast weight updates $k=5$, and interpolation parameter $\alpha =0.5$. We choose Lookahead optimizer because it has been shown to be robust to the initial parameters of the based optimizer (Adam). For Adam optimizer, we linearly increase the learning rate from $10^{-7}$ to $10^{-4}$ in the first 4000 updates and then follow an inverse square root decay. All RAMEN$_{\textsc {large}}$ models are optimized with Adam due to memory limit.
